strategyReview: The core engine is profitable thanks to the reliable Weekend HL Funding Reversion Long signal family (176/243 live wins, +0.47% avg, 188/253 shadow wins, +0.99%) which continues to scale. However, many auxiliary families are bleeding: FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG is -0.69% average on live trades, NO_BIAS_ADJUSTED_GAP shadows lose -1.30%, and several proxy-short shadows are deeply negative. The ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO signal shows stellar live returns but lacks depth; its shadow population has a marginal 0.09% average PnL and needs cleaner execution filters. The overall portfolio is healthy, but capital is being wasted on low-probability signal families that fail to convert shadow promise into live edge.

failureClusters.evidence: FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG_PM_PROXY_SHORT shadows avg -2.18% (3/15 wins), PC_RATIO_EXTREME_LOW_PM_PROXY_SHORT shadows 0% win, -7.15% avg PnL. The mechanism of proxying a perp short through buying NO on upside one-touch contracts is structurally misaligned, and the edge consistently disappears before expiry.
failureClusters.recommendation: Disable all polymarket proxy short shadow generation and prevent new hypotheses from these families; reallocating that capital to the live WEEKEND_HL_FUNDING_REVERSION_LONG would improve realized PnL.

failureClusters.evidence: NO_BIAS_ADJUSTED_GAP_SHADOW family shows 37/89 wins (42%), avg -1.30%, with losses dominated by gap disappearance. Even filtered clusters like FIND-0026 (9 shadows, 78% win) show high variance (std 20.78%), suggesting the signal lacks stability and is sensitive to small sample artifacts.
failureClusters.recommendation: Halt promotion of any no-bias gap shadows into live signals. Keep the family in exploratory mode but require a minimum of 50 resolved shadows and a profit factor above 1.5 before reconsidering.

failureClusters.evidence: Both H-534 and H-540 (ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO on GOLD heatmap cluster) have 0% win rate over 29 tests each, despite the shadow cluster FIND-0036 showing 75% win over only 8 samples. The high initial promise crashed on out-of-sample shadow tests, indicating severe overfitting.
failureClusters.recommendation: Kill H-534 and H-540 immediately. Do not promote any GOLD one-touch heatmap signals until a new, regime-relative cluster emerges with at least 20 resolved tests and a win rate above 55%.

newHypotheses.prediction: The OIL spot price will not reach the one-touch strike within the contract timeframe, and the sold YES will expire OTM or be bought back at a narrower edge.

newHypotheses.description: Rich PM IV one-touch NO: when the prediction market IV exceeds the 30d options IV by at least 10 percentage points and the one-touch strike is above the current spot price, sell YES on the one-touch NO contract, capturing the IV overpricing.
newHypotheses.prediction: The PM IV will mean-revert downwards, and the YES price will decay, causing the sold YES to expire worthless or be closed profitably within 7-14 days.

newHypotheses.prediction: The YES price will erode rapidly as expiry approaches and IV normalizes, delivering a profit within the contract's remaining term.

newHypotheses.description: Rich PM IV with edge 3-8 pts: on rich-IV NO contracts where the sell-YES edge is between 3 and 8 percentage points, the signal is especially robust; enter short when pm_iv > opt_iv_30d + 10 and sell_yes_edge_pts ∈ [3,8].
newHypotheses.prediction: The large edge indicates a pricing anomaly that will correct before expiry, yielding a positive return on the sold YES.

newHypotheses.description: No-bias gap short with direction below and near expiry: when the no-bias adjusted gap is positive (sell edge) and the one-touch direction is below current spot (i.e. the contract is an above-strike one-touch) AND days to expiry < 30, short by selling YES.
newHypotheses.prediction: The gap will close quickly as expiry nears, and the sold YES will lose value, resulting in a profitable short.

newHypotheses.description: ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO on ALL with above direction and edge 3-8 pts: for any asset, when the one-touch strike is above spot and the sell-YES edge is between 3 and 8 percentage points, enter a short via selling YES.
newHypotheses.prediction: The edge will revert and the YES price will deflate within 14 days, generating a profit on the short position.

newHypotheses.prediction: The GOLD YES premium will deflate as expiry approaches, leading to a profitable short via selling the one-touch YES.

journalEntry: Tonight's review confirms that the Weekend HL Funding Reversion Long family remains our powerhouse, with consistent live and shadow profitability. The focus must be on scaling this signal and not diluting the portfolio with noisy experiments. The ranked research opportunities from the latest mining run highlight a flow-asymmetry thesis (smart wallets on dips vs. dumb on highs) and a cluster of PM-IV-rich one-touch NO signals, both of which show strong in-sample promise. We've translated these into specific, testable hypotheses. Critically, we flagged three failure clusters: the persistent bleed of polymarket proxy shorts, the decaying no-bias gap shadows, and the disastrous GOLD one-touch heatmap hypotheses H-534 and H-540. Killing those two zombie hypotheses and halting new proxy-short generations should free mental and capital bandwidth. No parameter updates are justified tonight; the current risk settings are acceptable while we improve signal selection. Tomorrow night we should review the open weekend reversion positions for any outlier losers (LLY, EBAY) and consider if there's an asset-specific filter.
